data.name: Versatile Performance (Percussion Instruments)
data.description: You can use your bonus in the Perform (Percussion Instruments) skill in place of your bonus in the Handle Animal or Intimidate skills. When substituting in this way, you use your total Perform (Percussion Instruments) skill bonus, including class skill bonus, in place of your Handle Animal or Intimidate skill bonus, whether or not you have ranks in that skill or if it is a class skill.
